prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a lively beach volleyball tournament. On the left, a tall player in blue shorts leaps high, arm extended upward to spike the ball. Directly below him stands a teammate in white socks, hands raised ready to block. To their right, an opponent in a yellow bikini dives low across the sand, eyes fixed on the incoming sphere. Behind her, a referee in a striped shirt sits on a high chair, whistle hanging from his neck. In the center foreground, a red volleyball hangs suspended in mid-air, casting a faint shadow. Next to the net post, a cooler with a blue lid rests on the sand, condensation visible on its surface. A woman in a sun hat stands beside the cooler, holding a water bottle tightly. She looks toward a man in sunglasses who points aggressively at the court lines. Near them, a brown dog lies panting on a striped towel, tongue lolling out. The towel is partially buried under the dog's paws. On the right side of the frame, a child in a green shirt clutches a plastic shovel, staring wide-eyed at the action. Beside the child, a stroller with a pink canopy remains empty and still. An older man in a cap leans against the stroller handle, arms crossed over his chest. He watches a vendor in an apron who hands a paper cone of fries to a girl in a denim jacket. The girl takes the food while looking back at the game. Nearby, a seagull perches on a wooden fence post, head tilted curiously. The fence runs along the background, separating the court from a line of palm trees. One palm tree sways slightly, its fronds blurred by motion. There is no electronic scoreboard visible in the background. There is no professional camera equipment held by any spectator. There is no cloud cover in the sky above.
